![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

This file's new location under `espnet3/components/data/` introduces a dependency from the `components` package to the `parallel` package. Architecturally, `components` are expected to be foundational, reusable modules that should not depend on higher-level orchestration logic like the `parallel` framework. This dependency inversion might make the codebase harder to maintain, which seems to contradict the goal of this refactoring.

Given that `collect_stats` is tightly coupled with the parallel execution logic, consider moving `collect_stats.py` to a more appropriate location, such as `espnet3/parallel/` or `espnet3/utils/`, to better reflect its role and dependencies.
